text: A dated press release can re-enter a sweep as a fresh social repost: Gartner's 'AI coding token costs surpass average developer salary by 2028' story surfaced in an Instagram post dated 2026-11-13 and read as an in-window signal, while the Gartner newsroom release and the CIO Dive write-up are both dated 2026-06-24. The social post carries the same Peer Insights figures (23% spending $200-500/dev/month, 6% over $2,000) and no date of its own, so the whole leg was dropped at Stage 1. Any signal whose only in-window record is a repost or a quote-card must be traced to the publisher's own release date before it enters the table.

publish.py's Supabase metadata is built from an explicit key list and never writes metadata.synthesis, so a Synthesis artifact (frontmatter synthesis: true, both anchors under sources) persists without the fusion flag and no /api/articles.json badge can read it. verify.sh checks the artifact, not the row, so this passes every gate. Patch the row by hand or fix the builder before relying on metadata.synthesis.

check_accessibility counts a period inside an abbreviation as a sentence end, so a By-the-numbers bullet containing '5 p.m.' trips readability_critic's 'carries more than one sentence' rule on a one-sentence bullet. Write 'after-hours' or '5pm' in that block.

scripts/publish.py can persist an article with no illustration pass at all (no image_* fields in the artifact, no 'featured image' note in its output) and the CMS post goes live hero-less. Check published/<date>_<slug>.md for image_path before calling the run done: run scripts/illustration_creator.py --apply <artifact>, then scripts/wp_draft.py --slug <slug> --refresh --refresh-live to attach the media, then toggle the post status draft -> publish (a same-status PATCH does not fire the static front's rebuild) and re-curl the front to confirm og:image and the -1024x576 derivative.

The frontier rewrite deletes the draft's single inline internal link (the stitcher only counts [n] tags), so article_shape hard-fails zero inline links at the push. Restore it by hand in the _final.md and re-run the battery. Also pick a link slug with no digits in it: an inline link to /your-sso-bill-125-a-connection/ makes the review ledger read 'figure lost: 125', because the number lives in the URL, and the attempt is HELD for a figure nobody dropped.

scripts/test_illustration_overlay.py fails on checked-in code (4 tests, verify.sh red before and independent of any article): _subject_map multiplies the dominant-colour cue by weight = 0.25 + 0.75*texture, so a smooth subject on a textured ground scores ~0.24 where the test asserts >0.6 - the 2026-11-06 'detail weight' commit (4a28e00) is the likely regression. Do not blind-fix image placement mid-run: the weights exist to stop type landing on a lit wall, and the fix needs a design decision (probably weight the border-plate cue only and leave the modal-colour cue unweighted).
